StrmTool.PluginDescription: Extracts technical media information (codec, resolution, subtitles) from strm files to enhance library display and playback performance.
StrmTool.TaskDescription: Extracts technical media information (codec, resolution, subtitles) from strm files.
StrmTool.Subtitle: Extract audio, video codec, resolution, and subtitle streams from strm files to enhance media library display and instant playback performance
StrmTool.DescForceRefreshWarning: Force refresh significantly increases remote probing requests and may trigger rate limits on third-party cloud drives or WebDAV. Only enable during maintenance or troubleshooting.
StrmTool.LblEnableAutoExtract: Automatically extract media info for new strm files
StrmTool.DescEnableAutoExtract: When enabled, new strm files will automatically extract media info in the background without manual task execution
StrmTool.DescEnableMediaInfoCache: When enabled, extracted media info will be saved to xxx.strmtool.json files to avoid repeated probing
StrmTool.DescVerifyStrmContentHash: Enabled: URL changes invalidate the cache and trigger re-probing. Disable only when media is unchanged after a path move. Cache reads never update fingerprints; re-enabling rejects missing or mismatched fingerprints.
StrmTool.DescRefreshDelay: Milliseconds to wait after each media info refresh to avoid overwhelming remote servers
StrmTool.ResetSuccess: Restored default settings. Click Save to apply.
StrmTool.LoadFailed: Unable to load settings. Retry before saving.
StrmTool.DescMaxConcurrentExtract: Maximum number of concurrent background media extraction tasks (1-50)
StrmTool.DescForceRefreshIgnoreExisting: When enabled, will always execute refresh regardless of whether media stream info already exists (cache can still be used)
StrmTool.DescForceRefreshIgnoreCache: When enabled, will always fetch from remote server directly, ignoring cache files (will still check if media streams exist)
StrmTool.DescMetadataRestoreTimeout: Maximum time to wait for metadata restoration when strm file size is reset (1-30 minutes)
StrmTool.ExportTaskDescription: Exports existing media info of strm files into local .strmtool.json cache files without remote probing.
StrmTool.RestoreTaskName: Restore Strm Media Info from Cache
StrmTool.RestoreTaskDescription: Restores media streams and metadata for strm files from valid .strmtool.json cache files without remote probing.
